body:
**Tracked refactor (not a blocker).**

PR #401 (F2 Named Regimes + Partial Refund Decision) was built PRE the R81 `\u2264400 prod-LOC` rule and ships at ~595 prod LOC. Per operator ruling (2026-06-16), pre-rule PRs are grandfathered under a 1000-LOC hard limit and refactored down later. #401 is therefore cleared to merge; the cap finding is reclassified from P0 to this tracked refactor item.

**Refactor plan:** split along the two controllers \u2014 `RegimesController` (Named-Regimes CRUD) and `RefundDecisionsController` (partial-refund-decision surface). Target each module under the 400-LOC cap.

Ref: Auditor A correctness/security report on #401; BACKFILL_LEDGER 2026-06-16 entry in tgp-agent-context.
title: R82 refactor: split F2 Named Regimes (#401) under 400-LOC cap (pre-rule grandfather, 595 LOC)
